landing.title: Plan a trip in minutes
landing.subtitle: Answer a few questions and get a day-by-day itinerary on a map, with a budget, a packing list and a documents checklist. Edit everything by dragging; it re-plans when something changes.
landing.featuresHeading: What makes it more than a chat

map.title: Real places on a map
map.body: Every suggestion is matched to a real place with coordinates before you see it, and each day is grouped so you are not zig-zagging across town.

edit.title: Edit by dragging
edit.body: Reorder stops, move them between days, lock the ones you love and ask the AI to make a day more relaxed. Every change can be undone.

essentials.title: Everything in one place
essentials.body: Budget per day and category, a packing list, a documents checklist and the weather, saved together and shareable as a read-only link.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you were looking for does not exist or has moved.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: An unexpected error stopped this page from loading. Reloading usually fixes it.
